one_liner: Brex has a broad REST API with self-serve admin-generated user tokens for Brex customers, partner OAuth2, and an official hosted MCP server; requires an approved Brex business account.
auth_notes: Customers: admin-generated user token (Bearer) with scopes. OAuth2 authorization code is only for approved Brex partners (client ID/secret issued by Brex); client credentials for onboarding API. MCP server supports OAuth with DCR.
access_notes: No separate API fee for Brex customers, but requires an approved Brex business account and an admin accepting the Developer API agreement. No customer sandbox; staging is for partners only. OAuth for multi-tenant apps requires partner approval.
blocker_notes: Need an existing Brex business account with admin to create tokens; multi-user OAuth requires Brex partner approval. Token-based use works per customer.

evidence.quote: To start making calls to Brex APIs, generate a user token from your Brex dashboard and pass it along in your API call headers.
For all other APIs, you will implement the Authorization Code Grant, which implements a web-based redirection flow to request permission from the Brex client to access their account.
Access needs an approved Brex business account, so an agent can't start without one. There is no customer sandbox, and the staging server is for approved partners only.
This new open API is available to all Brex customers, free of charge.
make a GET request to https://api.brex.com/v2/users/me with your language/tool of choice.
The server is hosted at https://api.brex.com/mcp and supports any MCP-compatible client.
